name: FaceType
author: Echo Opera
description: Three-line rational and experimental motion typography. Type three lines in the inspector; independently animate line XY, scale, angle, opacity and ink.

inputs.label: Type
inputs.hint: Three lines, each with its own font, weight, size, tracking and alignment. Motif rasterizes them; the styles move them.

styles.name: Rational Grid
styles.blurb: Measured editorial hierarchy over a precise modular grid.

line1Pos.hint: Position in frame-normalized XY; each axis can be keyed independently.

line2Pos.hint: Position in frame-normalized XY; each axis can be keyed independently.
